question.text: Which of the following must be included in the Public Announcement for buyback as per Schedule II?

answer.text: Names of institutional shareholders who have pre-committed to tender
Three-year financial projections approved by auditors
Promoter and director shareholding details along with 6-month purchase/sale details with prices

explanation.text: The Logic: Schedule II mandates that the PA must include promoter/director shareholding details and the details of purchases and sales of shares by promoters/directors in the preceding 6 months along with prices paid/received. The Trap: "Projected post-buyback share price" sounds like useful investor information, but projecting share prices is speculative and is never required in regulatory disclosures. "Three-year financial projections" are also not required.
